The agreement between National Ocean Resources, Inc. (NORI), a wholly owned subsidiary of Deep Green Metals, Inc., and Texas A&M University (TAMU) is a 20 month collaboration to characterize and monitor the effect of deep water mining on the water column ecosystem in the CCZ region of the Pacific Ocean.  This is a fixed price agreement that does not specifically state that funds will be used to employ any personnel. TAMU retains the right to freely publish any results of the project as long as NORI and Deep Green Metals have been given the opportunity to review and comment on the publication, and TAMU acknowledges the award made available by the sponsor. TAMU and NORI will jointly own results jointly developed under the agreement. TAMU and NORI will individually own all patents, copyrights, and other intellectual property solely conceived or developed under the agreement. TAMU grants NORI non-exclusive, royalty-free license to any TAMU intellectual property developed under the agreement for non-commercial internal research and development only.

This is an addendum to the original agreement, dated July 14, 2020, between Nauru Ocean Resources, Inc. (NORI), a wholly owned subsidiary of Deep Green Metals, Inc., and Texas A&M University (TAMU) for $309,516. Through this addendum, the original project is extended by 90 days and additional work to characterize and monitor the effect of deep-water mining on the water column ecosystem in the CCZ region of the Pacific Ocean has been approved.  This addendum brings the total contract to $469,297.

Other than the work extension and additional funding, contract restrictions have not been added or modified. Original provisions include: TAMU retains the right to freely publish any results of the project as long as NORI and Deep Green Metals have been given the opportunity to review and comment on the publication, and TAMU acknowledges the award made available by the sponsor; TAMU and NORI will jointly own results jointly developed under the agreement; TAMU and NORI will individually own all patents, copyrights, and other intellectual property solely conceived or developed under the agreement; and TAMU grants NORI non-exclusive, royalty-free license to any TAMU intellectual property developed under the agreement for non-commercial internal research and development only.

Characterize the baseline oceanographic conditions and midwater communities (microbes to fish) in the eastern CCZ, specifically the NORI-D mining license area. On two cruises, the baseline will be characterized. On a third cruise, the water column will be surveyed during an experimental mining vehicle test that will create sediment clouds in the mesopelagic and in the benthic boundary layer just above the abyssal seafloor.
